enabled.description: Enables or Disables the ConfigMaps from folder feature

basePath.description: The path in your parent chart's filesystem where you can add files to be converted into individual ConfigMaps. Files should be organized two levels deep (basePath/configMapName/file)

configMapsOverrides.description: Define overrides for the generated ConfigMaps, each key is the name of a folder in basePath

forceRename.description: Force a specific name for the ConfigMap instead of the auto-generated name

fileAttributeOverrides.description: Configure how individual files are added to the ConfigMap

exclude.description: If true the file won't be added to the ConfigMap

binary.description: If your file is a binary file like an image, set this to true. Takes precedence over escaped

escaped.description: If your file contains gotpl syntax that you don't want templated by Helm, set this to true

description: Generate ConfigMaps from a folder structure in the Helm chart's filesystem
